readerContract.humanQuestion: What do I need to understand about AI, from the physical infrastructure through models, products, work and public consequences, so I can use it deliberately and recognise what a confident claim leaves out?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: The reader gains one connected foundational map, a separate direct-lookup route and a set of precise questions that help her use AI at work and home, test important claims and contribute to decisions without borrowing somebody else's confidence or jargon.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No engineering, coding or AI vocabulary is assumed. The reader only needs to recognise an ordinary task, product, workplace proposal or headline that uses the label AI.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: AI is not one object. Physical infrastructure enables training and use; training shapes a model; inference applies a trained model to current input; products add context, instructions, retrieval, tools, permissions and interfaces; workflows and institutions determine how outputs become actions; evidence and accountable human decisions determine what should be trusted or done.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: Short work, home and public-discussion situations reveal different parts of the same system: using an assistant for a real task, deciding what information it can use, questioning an automation proposal and reading claims about chips, energy, jobs, evidence or public services.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A durable, revisable, book-like explanation that works as six connected chapters plus a separate Concept Index for direct lookup. It is not a class transcript, provider catalogue, current product manual, news digest or glossary wall.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can finally see how the pieces fit together. I know which part a claim is about, what evidence or limitation matters and what useful question I can ask next.

strengthsToUse: Begin with human stakes before technical vocabulary.
Build a connected causal learning arc and keep the reader's judgment central.
Use warm, funny, practical language without hiding the mechanism.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not copy Episode 01's scene structure, length, reference density or three-tool comparison.
Do not inherit factual or product claims without current evidence.
Do not turn a durable book into an episode transcript.

strengthsToUse: Answer the reader's actual question early.
Separate solid, conditional, contested and unknown claims where the distinction changes the decision.
Turn evidence and uncertainty into a precise next question or action.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not inherit dated claims from the held artifact.
Do not repeat its answer scaffold across chapters or Concept Index entries.
Do not substitute isolated answers for the connected system explanation.

strengthsToUse: Make scope, date and evidence boundaries visible.
Use one analogy for one job and state its limit.
Return a broad claim to a practical reader question without overclaiming.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not import the article's legal-news format into the book.
Do not treat a dated NewsStand example as evergreen concept authority.
Do not copy its specific analogy or action when a chapter has a different mechanism.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: The six chapters own the connected system explanation. The Concept Index gives one-line recognition, chapter location and system relationship only; it cannot become the body architecture.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure and antiTemplateDecision keep sequential chapters and lookup entries as distinct jobs.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Each chapter follows its reader question and mechanism rather than a repeated definition, analogy, limit, example and action template.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: The chapter plan changes form by relationship: physical chain, training/inference contrast, information flow, capability boundary, multi-step loop and verification path.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: The representative successor includes no pre-authorized analogy. Any analogy requires an amended concept, mapping, limit and reason it reduces mental work before prose is produced.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: draftArchitecture.analogyPlan is empty; communicationDesign requires concrete mechanism and familiar-to-technical return without treating familiarity as sufficient.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Rewind Era and LAiDIES references enter only when removing them would make a distinction or consequence harder to understand or remember.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: The communication plan uses human situations and system visibility; humourSurprise is explicitly not required.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Every major section must trace what enters, what changes, what performs the operation, what emerges and which evidence or human decision remains outside the model.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: draftArchitecture.causalSequence connects physical infrastructure, training, inference, product capabilities, workflows, evidence and accountable decision.

genericAction.producerGuard: Chapter actions name the exact layer, evidence, date, permission, authority or consequence to inspect; phrases such as be careful, verify everything or use AI responsibly do not count.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: draftArchitecture.usefulAction supplies five diagnostic questions tied to the system map.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Introduce a technical term only after its observable job or problem is visible and only when the term makes the explanation more precise.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: communicationDesign begins from human reason and concrete visibility; the Concept Index routes back to the chapter mechanism.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Every concept and chapter reconnects to the single system map and to what changes for a real person, worker or public decision.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: readerContract.centralMentalModel and draftArchitecture.causalSequence preserve one end-to-end chain.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use adult, warm, exact prose with recognisable stakes, relief and earned wit. Reject textbook throat-clearing, maker-facing assurances and personality-free definitions.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: readerContract.desiredFeeling and communicationDesign bind curiosity, consequence and better-next-question outcomes while leaving humour optional.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: No single workplace or home case may become the reason for the book. The governing purpose is practical and civic AI literacy across use, claims and decisions.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: readerContract.humanQuestion, promisedPayoff and dailyLifeConnection span work, home and public consequences; workedCase is explicitly subordinate.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Every chapter establishes why its mechanism changes something the reader can use, question or decide before naming the technical sequence.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: communicationDesign requires humanQuestion and usefulCuriosity before invisibleProcessConcrete.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Examples illuminate one relationship and then return to the complete map. No fictional recommendation, employer or product becomes the book's identity.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: draftArchitecture.workedCase is one bounded workplace proposal among home and public cases; antiTemplateDecision keeps the book purpose primary.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Write like a smart colleague making a consequential system legible, not a standards document proving coverage. Cut process assurances and translate abstractions into people, information, operations and consequences.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: communicationDesign binds familiar-to-technical movement and a return to the reader's better next question.

opaqueChapterTitles.producerGuard: Every visible Introduction, chapter and Concept Index title states the reader's real question or names the actual subject. A deck may add scope but cannot rescue a maker-facing or metaphorical title that hides it.
opaqueChapterTitles.preventionEvidence: draftArchitecture.readerRoute binds each visible title to its reader question, coverage terms and stable destination; the shared checker rejects known opaque labels and titles that name none of their declared coverage.

prerequisiteOrderHiddenByTitles.producerGuard: A chapter cannot use training, context, retrieval or other dependent concepts before the visible route has introduced the model/system concept they depend on.
prerequisiteOrderHiddenByTitles.preventionEvidence: Chapter 1 answers what AI, a model, a product and the physical system are; Chapter 2 then explains training and inference; Chapter 3 then explains the information supplied during use. readerRoute.prerequisiteIds makes that order executable.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: AI literacy means seeing the whole chain behind the label: physical infrastructure makes computation possible; training produces a model; inference uses it; products add information, tools, permissions and interfaces; organisations turn outputs into actions; evidence and accountable people decide what should be trusted or done.
causalSequence: Chips, servers, networks, data centres, electricity, cooling, capital and labour make computing capacity possible.
Training data, objectives, evaluation choices and computing work shape a model before the reader's present task.
During inference, the trained model processes the current input and produces a result appropriate to its model type.
A product assembles instructions, current context and permitted retrieval or tool results around the model.
Workflows and agents may repeat model and tool steps, but permissions, stopping rules, monitoring and accountability remain designed outside the model.
People and institutions decide where outputs enter work, markets or public services and who can contest an error or consequence.
The reader locates a claim in this chain, checks its evidence and date, names what is missing and chooses the next useful question or action.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A bounded workplace proposal to use AI for meeting preparation and follow-up travels through infrastructure, model, current context, retrieval permissions, workflow design, evidence checking and accountable managerial decisions. The case illuminates individual relationships but remains one example among home and public-service cases; it does not define the book's purpose.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: Without a supplied solution, the reader analyses a claim that a community service will use AI to reduce waiting times. She identifies the physical/product/model/workflow layers involved, the information and permissions required, the evidence that would support the promised outcome, who carries error and access consequences and the next question she would ask before supporting the proposal.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: When an AI feature, output, workplace proposal or headline matters, ask: Which layer is this claim actually about? What information, permission or evidence shapes the result? What changed between training and this use? What important person, cost, uncertainty or consequence is missing? Who retains authority and what evidence would change the decision?

analogyPlan.concept: The app is a doorway into a wider AI system, not the whole system.
analogyPlan.analogy: Internet Explorer was the doorway many Rewind Era readers used for the internet; it was not the internet itself.
analogyPlan.mapping: The familiar app icon maps to the AI product interface, while the wider networks, computers and services behind it map to the surrounding AI system.
analogyPlan.limit: AI systems are not internet architecture, and the analogy does not explain model training, inference or product-specific components.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It corrects the common collapse of app, model and AI system using a remembered distinction, then immediately returns to the real components.

analogyPlan.concept: Only information supplied in the current working context can directly shape this model response.
analogyPlan.analogy: At Miss Jeeves's LIBRAiRY desk, the catalogue, shelves, saved note and books in the building are different from the exact pages placed on the working desk for one answer.
analogyPlan.mapping: The working desk maps to current context, desk capacity to the context window, the ongoing exchange to conversation state, a saved patron note to product memory and a catalogue fetch to retrieval.
analogyPlan.limit: The model is not a librarian, does not independently understand source authority and may use supplied information unevenly or incorrectly.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: One coherent town-world scene makes five easily collapsed information states visible without turning them into five unrelated comparisons.

humourPlan.lessonJob: The line 'the cloud has a postcode' punctures the false sense that AI is immaterial and opens the physical infrastructure mechanism; any other wit must sharpen a distinction rather than decorate the page.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Introduction: What changes when you actually understand AI? Chapter 1: What is AI, exactly? Chapter 2: How does an AI model learn—and what happens when you use it? Chapter 3: Why does AI forget things you already told it? Chapter 4: How can AI search, calculate and take actions? Chapter 5: How does AI carry out a multi-step job? Chapter 6: Why can AI sound convincing and still be wrong? Then a separate Concept Index: Where can I look up one AI term? Every visible route includes a plain coverage deck.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: The book body is one connected explanation, not a repeated entry set. Chapters answer different reader questions and use different explanatory forms because their mechanisms differ. The Concept Index performs compact recognition and routing only. Communication dimensions are outcomes to earn, not seven compulsory subheadings or a copied Hannah Fry format.

entries.title: What changes when you actually understand AI?
entries.readerQuestion: Why is understanding AI useful if I am not trying to build it?
entries.coverage: How a working system map improves everyday use, exposes weak claims and gives the reader a useful place in workplace and public decisions.

entries.title: What is AI, exactly?
entries.readerQuestion: What am I actually using when I open an AI app?
entries.coverage: The difference among an AI system, product and model; the physical chips, servers, data centres, electricity, cooling and networks behind the screen; and the path from input to output.

entries.title: How does an AI model learn—and what happens when you use it?
entries.readerQuestion: How can training create a model that later produces a result from my request?
entries.coverage: Training data, objectives, parameter adjustment, evaluation, inference, tokens, representative model jobs and the difference between generation and verification.

entries.title: Why does AI forget things you already told it?
entries.readerQuestion: Why can a product show my earlier information but fail to use it in the current answer?
entries.coverage: Prompt, current context, context window, chat history, session state, files, product memory, retrieval and the boundary from training.

entries.title: How can AI search, calculate and take actions?
entries.readerQuestion: What lets an AI product do more than generate an answer?
entries.coverage: Retrieval, tools, APIs, MCP, permissions, routing, wrappers and harnesses around a model.

entries.title: How does AI carry out a multi-step job?
entries.readerQuestion: What turns one model response into a workflow or agent that continues working?
entries.coverage: Workflows, agents, sub-agents, skills, loops, observations, permissions, monitoring and stopping.

entries.title: Why can AI sound convincing and still be wrong?
entries.readerQuestion: Where can an AI-assisted result or claim fail, and which repair matches the failed layer?
entries.coverage: Missing input, stale retrieval, model error, tool or permission failure, interface omission, hallucination, evidence, contestability and human responsibility.

entries.title: Where can I look up one AI term?
entries.readerQuestion: Where does one unfamiliar word belong in the complete system?
entries.coverage: Stable A–Z term anchors with a one-line meaning, chapter location and explicit relationship to the system map.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Apply the communication mechanics to a scannable, resumable Library book. Use question-led chapter openings, concrete cases, deterministic diagrams and return questions where they reduce mental work; do not reproduce the pacing, performance, personality or structure of a television talk, lecture or Hannah Fry book.

humanQuestion.reason: A foundational map matters only when the reader sees how it changes her use, judgment and participation.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Open the representative Chapter 3 successor with an ordinary moment when a product appears to remember something and the reader needs to know what information is actually available now.

usefulCuriosity.reason: Prediction can reveal the common collapse of context, session history, saved memory and training data.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Before naming the terms, ask which of several pieces of information the system can actually use in the present task, then resolve the prediction through the mechanism.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: The assembly and movement of current task information happen out of view and are easily mistaken for human-like remembering.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Trace one exact request through instructions, current message, conversation history, attached material, retrieval result, context window and model inference, supported by the smallest deterministic flow diagram.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: The reader must move from a familiar product experience into the correct technical distinctions and back to the decision about what to provide or trust.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Return from context, session, memory and retrieval definitions to the opening task and show which missing layer to repair without implying that the product remembers everything.

limitationsConsequences.reason: What a product stores, retrieves or exposes can change accuracy, privacy, permissions and the consequences of relying on an answer.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: State what the chapter map cannot infer about a specific product, distinguish current context from training and retained account data, and show the consequence of supplying or assuming the wrong information.

humourSurprise.reason: The representative proof can be engaging through a recognisable mistaken assumption and its reveal; a joke is not needed to establish the mechanism.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The reader needs a reusable way to interrogate another product without memorising its current interface.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: End the representative section with: What information is actually available for this run, where did it come from, what persists afterward and what would I need to supply or verify?

explanationArc.sharedStartingPoint: AI now appears in ordinary tools, workplace proposals, headlines and public decisions, while most explanations begin with jargon or one branded app.
explanationArc.curiosityGap: What is actually happening between a human goal and an AI-assisted result, and which parts should the reader use, question or keep under human judgement?
mechanismSequence: A physical and software system receives a human goal and input through a product.
Training has already shaped a model's parameters; during inference the model processes the material supplied for this use.
The product decides which current message, history, files, memory and retrieved material enter the bounded working context.
The model produces a result from that supplied material, while surrounding software may add tools or actions.
Evidence, consequences, permissions and accountable human judgement determine what should happen next.
explanationArc.earnedClick: There is no single all-knowing 'AI' making the decision: there is a chain of physical infrastructure, trained models, current information, surrounding software, evidence and people—and different failures require different repairs.
explanationArc.smallLanding: When an AI result matters, locate the layer before you decide what to trust, change or ask next.
explanationArc.safetyBoundary: State from the beginning that an AI output is not automatically evidence or a decision; do not infer a named product's retention, limits, permissions or behaviour from the general map.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: A complete-looking book can still become a fluent technical tour: terms and diagrams may be accurate while curiosity, concrete mental visibility and the return to the reader's real decision are missing or repeated mechanically.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: After this amended contract passes, produce one new exact candidate containing the Introduction and Chapters 1–3 plus their readable contents route and text-equivalent visual callouts. It must be new exact bytes created after the contract and may source-mine but never copy or splice predecessor prose. Run exact-prose producer self-review before any role-distinct review. If Ali accepts the bounded beginning, newly produce Chapters 4–6 and the Concept Index as one coherent successor under the same current contract; no predecessor prose may enter the assembled book.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: An unfamiliar reader can explain why AI literacy matters; distinguish AI system, product and model; describe the physical path from request to computation; distinguish training from inference; explain tokens without reducing an LLM to simple autocomplete; distinguish current context, visible history, product memory, retrieval and training; and apply the map to a new case. The prose must be recognisably LAiDIES, enjoyable, source-reviewable and free of vague headings. Bounded acceptance authorizes remaining full-book production only; it does not admit the candidate or permit a mixed-version book.
